title: Experience Partner, Real Estate Leasing and Operations
searchText: Experience Partner, Real Estate Leasing and Operations  Reddit Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 121 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com . The Experience Team at Reddit designs and delivers intentional, inclusive workplace experiences. We create environments and moments of connection that are thoughtfully built to support our employees, known as Snoos. Through innovative workplace design and curated engagements, our focus is enabling Snoos to do their best work and feel connected to the company and one another. This role will be a part of the Experience team and will sit on the Global Real Estate arm of the team. The Experience Partner, Real Estate Leasing and Operations is responsible for the strategic management and optimization of the company’s global real estate portfolio. This role drives data-informed portfolio planning, lease administration oversight, financial performance, and space optimization to support the company’s growth and evolving workplace strategy. The ideal candidate is highly analytical, detail-oriented, and experienced in managing complex global lease negotiations and portfolios within a fast-paced technology environment and is extremely comfortable working with Senior Leadership teams to drive forward data-based strategic decisions. This role is expected to travel to be onsite at locations when necessary for real estate projects. Key Responsibilities: Serve as the strategic owner of Reddit’s global real estate portfolio operations, overseeing lease lifecycle management, portfolio planning, and governance across all office locations. Develop and execute portfolio strategies aligned to workforce planning, hybrid work models, and long-term business growth helping identify opportunities for consolidation, expansion, and cost optimization across regions. Lead end-to-end lease administration, including renewals, expirations, options, lease abstracts, CAM reconciliations, landlord compliance, and critical date management. Build and maintain financial models to support renewals, exits, restructures, and new market entry; develop forecasts, variance analyses, and long-range portfolio plans to inform executive decision-making. Partner cross-functionally with Finance, HR, Workplace, Procurement, Legal, and external brokers to drive successful transactions, ensure alignment with business priorities, and support scenario planning and headcount modeling. Leverage workplace analytics and utilization data to inform portfolio decisions, space planning assumptions, and operational strategy. Maintain accurate, real-time portfolio data across lease administration systems; establish portfolio management standards, reporting dashboards, and executive-ready insights. Drive process improvements, operational rigor, and automation initiatives across the GRE function; manage third-party lease administration and portfolio vendors as needed. At a Minimum, We’d Like You to Have: 5+ years of experience in corporate real estate, including commercial lease negotiations and lease lifecycle management across multiple locations. Deep understanding of commercial lease structures and market dynamics, including fluency in key lease terms (e.g., TI allowances, CAM, rent escalations, options, abatements) and the ability to evaluate competitive market conditions. Strong financial and analytical skills, with the ability to build clear financial models, portfolio plans, and executive-ready planning materials. Strong written and verbal communication skills that translate into presenting recommendations to senior leadership and driving alignment in high-visibility decision forums. Advanced ability to visualize and translate complex data into clean, comprehensive dashboards and planning sheets. Exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. A strong design sensibility and the ability to approach workplace challenges through creative, thoughtful design solutions. Pay Transparency: This job posting may span more than one career level. In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/ . To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below. The base salary range for this position is: $143,600 — $201,000 USD In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews. During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors . Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve. Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know. Reddit is a community of communities.
